title: Common-enemy fidelity: slimes, demon eyes, bats, cursed skulls, wyverns at boss quality
player_outcome: The first enemies you meet look as good as the bosses: slimes are translucent jelly with something visible inside, demon eyes are veined with coloured irises, bats have membrane wings, cursed skulls are proper skulls and the wyvern is a real dragon.
design: Verified: gel is 420 tris with an opaque prop:gel that hides its inner sphere (creatures.py:60-66); demon_eye 550; cave_bat 192; cursed_skull 768 (old bosses.skull); wyvern uses the old worm_segment. The boss helpers live in bosses_pre*.py.

Move the reusable helpers (_slime_body, _slime_face, _eyeball, _optic_nerves, skeletron_skull) into bgen/detail.py (or a new detail_parts.py if detail.py nears 400), keeping bosses_pre imports working.
gel: _slime_body(alpha 0.7, prop:gel:clear) at ~1.5k tris, keeping the inner item sphere visible; the per-enemy tint still colours it.

demon_eye: _eyeball with 5 vein trees + 3 optic nerves (~1.5k). cave_bat: organic body + ears + membrane wings with finger struts (prop:fur from P3-43) and a flap clip. cursed_skull: small skeletron_skull (~1.2k) with a glow. wyvern: dragon head with a fur mane, segments with small legs, tail fin.
Retire superseded generators still registered (bosses.py gel_sovereign, watcher, worm_segment, skull) once unused.
files_modify: tools/blender/bgen/bosses_pre.py, bosses_pre2.py — import helpers from detail
files_add: tools/blender/bgen/detail_parts.py — moved boss helpers (only if detail.py would exceed 400 lines)
verification: preview.py sheets; perf with 20 slimes on screen (render.primitives probe within budget)
risks: The translucent gel shader costs more with many slimes; check the low preset.
Keep boss GLBs byte-identical after the helper move (rebuild King Slime and diff tri counts).
